question: Refer to the exhibit. Software downgrade is required on a Cisco Nexus 7000 Series switch. What is displayed when this command is executed?
options: features that are enabled automatically after the downgrade
impact of a software upgrade in ISSU and chassis reload
features and commands that are removed automatically from the configuration
compatibility of software in the system bootflash file
theory: Before downgrading, "show incompatibility-all" checks the currently running configuration against the target (older) image and reports which currently configured features and commands are not supported by that older image — information the administrator needs because those unsupported features/commands would be automatically stripped from the configuration during the downgrade. It does not describe post-downgrade auto-enabled features, ISSU/reload impact (that's "show install all impact"), or generic bootflash file compatibility. (CCNP/CCIE DCCOR Official Cert Guide, Chapter 6 — Pre-Downgrade Compatibility Checks)
